'''Henia Kinalos''' was the daughter of [[Kinalos]] and his partner [[Tanne Kinalos|Tanne]]. She had at least two brothers.<ref name="Author'sCut" />

Henia lived on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] with her family around the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She owned a stuffed toy [[Felinx/Legends|felinx]]. During the [[Imperial Civil War]] that followed in the aftermath of the [[Second Battle of Coruscant]] in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], the [[Unidentified residential building (Coruscant)|Kinalos home]] was occupied by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Imperial Stormtroopers]]. Henia and the rest of her family were forced to flee, leaving many of their possessions behind. They were presumably [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the infighting. [[Kinalos|Her father]], serving with the [[New Republic Army]], later returned to his ruined home, clearing Imperial forces from it before abandoning it for good.<ref name="Author'sCut" />
